_comments: BILL.COM SCHEDULER ADAPTERS (golive #146/#148). Own dot-json, like .orders-renewal-actions.json.
MJ's scheduler dispatches Actions; no driver takes an operation key. These two rows are the adapters
for Orders.SendExternalInvoices and Orders.PollExternalPayments. The classes behind them hold no
SAFE TO SHIP Active: nothing invokes them until the ScheduledJobs in metadata/scheduled-jobs/ are
enabled, and those ship Disabled and configured for Preview.

fields.Name: Send External Invoices
fields.Description: Work the external invoicing worklist: every billing unit that is invoiceable on its company's Bill.com rail and not yet sent is created there through Orders.IssueExternalInvoice. Runs the Orders.SendExternalInvoices operation, which carries the selection, the idempotency guard and the tie check — this Action only reads parameters and reports the result. Preview lists what would be sent and sends nothing.
fields.UserPrompt: Send the invoices that are due to Bill.com, or preview what would be sent.

fields.Name: CompanyIDs
fields.Description: Restrict the sweep to these selling companies (comma-separated IDs). Omit for every company with an active Bill.com provider row. A value that is not a list of IDs is refused.

fields.Name: MaxCount
fields.Description: Cap on units sent in one pass, and on the units a preview lists, so the list confirmed at the go-live gate is the pass that follows it. The first-run safety valve: a mis-configuration invoices this many customers, not the book. Default 25. A value that is not a whole number of at least 1 is refused, never dropped: a dropped cap is no cap.

fields.Name: Preview
fields.Description: True lists what WOULD be sent and sends nothing; false (the default) sends. A value that is neither is refused rather than guessed — the wrong guess sends customers invoices. A scheduler stores params as text, so "false" arrives as a string and is read as false, not as a truthy value.

fields.Name: RetryTransientFailures
fields.Description: True (the default) also retries units whose last send failed for a transient reason — a timeout, a 5xx, a lost session. Permanent failures (a customer with no email) are never retried; they wait in the Bill.com queue for a person.

fields.Name: Sent
fields.Description: Units created on the rail this pass (or that would be, on a preview).

fields.Name: Failed
fields.Description: Units the rail or the tie check refused; each reason is on Results.

fields.Name: Skipped
fields.Description: Units beyond MaxCount, in flight, or permanent failures. Not lost — still due next pass or waiting for a person.

fields.Name: Results
fields.Description: Every unit considered, with its outcome. The deliverable of a preview run — stored on the ScheduledJobRun, where the person confirming the list reads it.

fields.Name: PreviewedOnly
fields.Description: True when this pass was a rehearsal. Deliberately not named Preview, so the input's record survives.

fields.Name: Poll External Payments
fields.Description: Read receivable payments from each company's Bill.com rail since the stored watermark and capture every cleared payment exactly once through Orders.CapturePayment, applied to the orders its invoices belong to. Runs the Orders.PollExternalPayments operation — this Action only reads parameters and reports the result. Preview decides everything and writes nothing. A pass that leaves unmatched or reversed payments for a person reports failure so the job notifies.
fields.UserPrompt: Poll Bill.com for cleared customer payments and record them, or preview what would be recorded.

fields.Name: PaymentProviderID
fields.Description: Poll one provider row (one company's Bill.com organisation) only. Omit for every active one.

fields.Name: Preview
fields.Description: True decides every payment and writes nothing — no Payment rows, no dispositions, no watermark. False (the default) records. A value that is neither is refused rather than guessed. A scheduler stores params as text, so "false" arrives as a string and is read as false.

fields.Name: MaxCount
fields.Description: Cap on payments considered per provider in one pass. Default 100. The remainder is read next pass (the watermark does not advance past a capped pass). A value that is not a whole number of at least 1 is refused.

fields.Name: SinceWatermark
fields.Description: Override the stored watermark (ISO 8601) for a first run or a deliberate re-read. Safe: dedupe is by Bill.com payment id and by PaymentHeader.IdempotencyKey. An unreadable value is refused.

fields.Name: Captured
fields.Description: Payments recorded this pass.

fields.Name: Held
fields.Description: Payments not yet cleared, or with a status the decision table does not know.

fields.Name: Unmatched
fields.Description: Payments applied to a Bill.com invoice Orders did not issue. Nothing captured; a person decides.

fields.Name: Refused
fields.Description: Payments Orders.CapturePayment refused — a split-company order, an ambiguous payer, a configuration fault. Nothing captured; a person decides. Counts as attention.

fields.Name: ReversalNeeded
fields.Description: Payments captured earlier that Bill.com now reports void or failed. Reverse through the bank-return path.

fields.Name: Ignored
fields.Description: Payments already known and unchanged.

fields.Name: Outcomes
fields.Description: Every payment considered, with its disposition and reason. Stored on the ScheduledJobRun.

fields.Name: NewWatermarks
fields.Description: The watermark each provider row ended the pass on.

fields.Name: PreviewedOnly
fields.Description: True when this pass was a rehearsal.
